paite: Vuah nanung hun in TOUPA vuah ngen un, meipite bawlpa TOUPA mahmah, huchi in vuahphinte, gam a loupate kiang ah, amaute ape ding.
heading: TOUPA'N Hotkhiakna Achiam
english: Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

paite: Milimte'n bangmah lou thu agen un, aisante'n zuau amu uh; mang zuauthei agen ua, athawn lel in alungmuan uh; huaiziak in belamte bang in amau lampi ah apai ua, belamchingmi a-om louh ziak in hihgim in a-om uhi.
english: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.

paite: "Belamching mite tung ah ka hehna apuakzak a, aheutute uh ka gawt ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Judah inkote, abelamte avehta a, kidouna a sakol hoih bang in amaute abawl ding hi.
english: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for Yahweh of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

paite: Amah a kipan in aning a suang, amah a kipan puanin khetphim amah a kipan kidouna thalpeu, amah a kipan vaihawm tengteng ahong paikhe ding hi.
english: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

paite: Kidouna a kongzing a buannawi a amelmate uh childen in, mihatte bang in a-om ding ua; akiang ua TOUPA a-om ziak in adou ding uh; sakol tung a tuangte hih lungzin in a-om ding uhi."
english: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because Yahweh is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

paite: "Judah inkote ka hatsak ding a, Joseph inkote ka hondam ding, amaute ka hon pi nawn ding a, amau tung ah zahngaihna ka nei; huchi in ka paihkhiak het louh bang ahong hi ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi a, amaute ka dawng ding hi.
english: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am Yahweh their God, and I will hear them.

paite: Ephraim mite mihatpa in a-om ding ua, uain ziak in alungtang uh akipak ding a; ahi, atate un huai amu ding ua, akipak ding uh; TOUPA ah alungtang uh akipak ding hi.
english: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in Yahweh.

paite: Amau ka khutvan ding a, amau ka kaikhawm ding; amau ka tanta hi; apun khitsa bang un apung ding uh.
english: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.

paite: Namte lak ah hawldalh mah leng; gam gamlate ah kei ahon theigige ding uh; huchi in atate uh toh ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn ding uhi.
english: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan ka pi nawn ding a, Assuria a kipan ka pikik nawn ding hi; Gilead leh Lebanon gam ah amau ka pilut ding; amaute a dia mun akidaih louh dong in
english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.

paite: gimthuakna tuipi apalkai ding ua, tuipi a tui kihawtte khet in a-om ding uh, huchi in Nile luipi thukna tengteng akang vek ding; Assuria kisaktheihna koihniam in a-om dia, Aigupta kumpi chiang apaimang vengveng ding hi.
english: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

paite: Huan TOUPA ah amau ka hihhat ding a; amin in avaktou un avaksuk ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will strengthen them in Yahweh. They will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
